question: Do the hand-picked schedule constraints (warmup=6, gap caps 6/10, phase boundary 21) earn their keep, or can a measured-cost DP replace them?

aggregation_cross.q90: derived from the contract failure gate alpha=0.10

device_gate.prompts: 24 odd holdout, seed 2, same harness and control data as V10/V11
device_gate.verdict: offline -51% inverted to +69% worse under real feedback

interpretation.mechanism: the additive cost model prices early skips cheap (small delta-sigma), but early deviations are multiplied through the forty-plus subsequent model invocations; the production dense warmup bounds early path deviation, encoding feedback knowledge the offline model cannot see
interpretation.reclassification: warmup/gap caps/phase boundary move from hand-picked-ugliness to feedback-constraints-awaiting-derivation; deletion is refuted, derivation (path-deviation envelope in the DP) is the honest fix
interpretation.theme: third independent instance of the reversal: weights, depth segments, now schedules — teacher-forced optima concentrate their aggression exactly where feedback amplification is strongest
interpretation.q90_note: the contract-derived aggregation quantile remains a valid provenance fix, orthogonal to this reversal
